problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user awareness training and phishing simulations

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing emails crafted using personal information to deceive specific individuals into revealing sensitive data or executing malicious actions.
risk_reduction: Train employees to recognize social engineering tactics
Use email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Limit publicly available personal information on social media

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive information from employees.
risk_reduction: Verify unusual requests through secondary communication channels
Implement strict transaction approval workflows
Monitor email accounts for anomalous login behavior

problems.description: Use of AI-generated synthetic media (deepfake audio/video) to impersonate trusted individuals and manipulate victims into unauthorized actions.
risk_reduction: Establish verification protocols for sensitive requests
Educate employees on deepfake risks
Deploy deepfake detection tools

problems.description: Publicly exposed cloud storage buckets (e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob) leading to data leakage or unauthorized access.
risk_reduction: Enforce least privilege access policies
Regularly audit cloud storage permissions
Use automated tools to detect misconfigurations

problems.description: Attackers inject malicious code or backdoors into trusted third-party software or libraries, compromising downstream consumers.
risk_reduction: Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) tracking
Use code signing and integrity verification
Monitor for anomalous behavior in third-party components

problems.description: Attackers manipulate input data to deceive or evade machine learning models used in security controls or business processes.
risk_reduction: Incorporate adversarial training and robust model validation
Monitor model outputs for anomalies
Deploy explainable AI techniques to detect manipulation

problems.description: Malware that operates in-memory or uses legitimate system tools to evade detection and persist without writing files to disk.
risk_reduction: Implement behavior-based endpoint detection and response (EDR)
Restrict use of scripting environments and macros
Monitor for anomalous process behavior
